title: Not just for wine - every day use as well!
text: Not just for wine - every day use as well!. These are fantastic glasses! Beautiful design, ergonomically fits perfectly in my hand and well made (sturdy glass). I can see where these will be very resistant to breakage (unlike a lot of stem wine glasses I have). However, I must point out that these can be use for most any purpose (also unlike wine stem glasses). I have used them for orange juice in the morning at my breakfast table. In any event, these are beautiful, strong glasses. Another quality product by Schott Zwiesel! A must have for any homeowner/apartment dweller. Would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift for sure!

product_metadata.title: Schott Zwiesel Tritan Studio Collection All Purpose Wine Tumbler Crystal Glass, Buy 6 Get 2 Free
features: Set of 8 Studio collection stemless all purpose wine tumbler; for use with wine and beverages; 16 ounce capacity, 4.75-inches tall, 3.38-inches wide
Tritan crystal glass: non-lead material of titanium and zirconium oxide; resists breakage, chipping, scratching; thermal shock resistant; patented
Studio collection: universal shape works for all types of wine and beverages; comfortable for all hand sizes; classic bowl design
Completely dishwasher safe; will not etch, cloud or discolor for the life of the glass
description: Schott Zwiesel, the famed German producer of "The Best Crystal Glassware" has been a leader in innovation, style and technology for more than 100 years. The company has many firsts to its credit, including the first fully automated product of glass blown glass stemware. In the 1990's, as the glass industry struggled with the environmental issues of lead and other heavy metals in crystal, the company was the first glassmaker to produce lead-free crystal glass of superb quality and brilliance. Schott Zwiesel created Tritan Crystal in 2001 by adding titanium oxide and zirconium oxide to develop "The World's Best Crystal Glass". Our patented Tritan technology makes our glass dishwasher safe and break-resistant, and features crystal brilliance. Enjoy it every day, knowing that sommeliers around the world choose these elegant glasses for professional use. Features of Tritan crystal glass: Meticulously designed shapes to draw out the complexity of your wine's unique characteristics; Sparkling clarity to reveal the nuance of your wine's color; Titanium strength gives you the confidence to use this brilliant, beautiful stemware every day; The graceful shape of the bowl aerates the wine and delivers it to your palette at the peak of perfection. The Studio collection offers a universal shape that is great for all types of wine and beverages. It feels comfortable for all hand sizes and features a classic bowl design. The all purpose wine tumbler is 4.75-inches tall, 3.38-inches wide and has a 16 ounce capacity. This glass in made in Germany and is dishwasher safe.
